STP.semantics: Accm <- Accm + clamp(src - Accm, -Temp, +Temp); Temp < 0 -> EW6

BCP.semantics: masked copy of the GO's take-set: inbox -> block store, sweep item -> SWEEP.a; HK only (EW4)

address_map.0x000-0x07F: block store, 8 blocks x 16 slots; datapath write only in HK (else EW4)
address_map.0x080-0x0FF: inbox view (+0xE = staged RT.OUT, +0xD reads 0); read-only (STM -> EW3)
address_map.0x100-0x10F: CUR alias = block order[q] of the packet now playing; write only inside a packet window (else EW4)
address_map.0x110-0x117: COMMIT[b] view: [15:0] mask, [16] RT.OUT bit, [29] copied, [30] armed-in-take-set; read-only
address_map.0x11A: sequencer status [3:0] q, [7:4] P, [8] HK phase; read-only

StayVal.s.written_by: sweep sequencer (prefetch of N of the next packet's block)

StayVal.p.loaded_at: Stay Set (N for a packet Stay, 0 otherwise)

profile_errors.EW2: block N outside [N_MIN, NMAX] at prefetch -> Error HALT (W-R9, extended by W-R13)
profile_errors.EW3: STM into a read-only region (inbox, COMMIT view, status) -> Error HALT
profile_errors.EW4: write-window violation: store write outside HK not via CUR; CUR write outside a packet window; BCP outside HK -> Error HALT
profile_errors.EW5: invalid sweep word at BCP: P > 8, repeated block among the first P, or sum N > NMAX -> Error HALT
